weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. Grants Res+3. Grants Atk+4 to allies within 3 spaces during combat. Inflicts Atk-4 on any foe within 3 spaces during combat.

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

Grants another action to target ally and grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+3 to target ally for 1 turn. Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of target ally through foes' next actions. (Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance. This skill treated as Sing or Dance.)

a.d: If magic, staff, or dragonstone foe initiates combat, unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range, disables foe's skills that "calculate damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res," and grants Atk/Res+5 to unit during combat.

b.d: If unit's HP ≥ 90% and foe initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 80% and foe initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 70% and foe initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

c.d: Inflicts Atk/Def-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Def-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
